payload.claim: The `unpackaged_state` marker — the whole point of which, per this function's own docstring, is that 'nobody reading the branch mistakes this for a commit PACKAGE produced' — is never asserted by any test. `test_the_squash_body_carries_provenance_and_defanged_subjects` checks the packaged commit body but never calls `commit_squash` with `unpackaged_state` set, and none of the seven new `push_unpackaged_work` tests inspects the pushed commit's message at all (they only check `result.pushed`, `result.branch`/`pushed_sha`, and ledger/remote state). Deleting the `if unpackaged_state is not None: lines += [...]` block entirely would make every pushed-unpackaged commit read exactly like a normal packaged one, and every test in the diff would still pass.
